human phosphomannumutase (PMM) and l-3- phosphoserine phosphatases (PSP) are members of a new family of phosphotransferases that form acyl-phosphate intermediates.

the identification and functional characterization of the amino acid residues that are phosphorylated in the phosphomutase and phosphatase reaction.
